Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0703: tests/ui/ffi_no_cargo.stderr.

Error [E0703]: can't call foreign Rust crates without `cargo`
 Why: Jet builds a small helper crate for each `extern rust` dependency set
 Fix: install Rust from https://rustup.rs (this includes `cargo`), then try again
